name: @ma-ui/tailwind
description: ma-ui design tokens and themes for Tailwind CSS v4 (daisyUI-compatible theme format)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/theme.ts ./src/themes/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --target node --format esm --external tailwindcss && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/theme.ts ./src/themes/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --target node --format esm --external tailwindcss --watch
